title: System Integrator
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a System Integrator with hands-on experience in network infrastructure implementation, integration, and troubleshooting. The candidate will be responsible for deploying and integrating network devices, switches, firewalls, load balancers, authentication systems, and monitoring solutions to ensure seamless connectivity, security, and high availability across enterprise environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Implement and integrate enterprise network infrastructure based on HLD and LLD documents.
* Install, configure, and integrate network switches and routers from Cisco, HPE, Aruba, and Juniper.
* Configure VLANs, Layer 2/Layer 3 switching, inter-VLAN routing, STP, VRRP, BGP, and link aggregation.
* Install and configure Fortinet FortiGate and SonicWALL firewalls, including security policies, firewall rules, and access controls.
* Configure and integrate F5 BIG-IP LTM load balancers, including virtual servers, pools, and health monitors.
* Integrate network devices with RADIUS/ISE authentication and SNMP-based monitoring platforms.
* Perform connectivity testing, integration testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution during deployment.
* Coordinate with customers, vendors, and internal technical teams for implementation and system integration activities.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity, application reachability, firewall, and routing issues.
* Monitor network performance and support incident management to maintain service availability.
* Prepare and maintain network diagrams, configuration documents, implementation plans, and SOPs.
* Support infrastructure upgrades, device replacements, and production deployment activities.

**Required Skills**

* 4–6 years of experience in System Integration, Network Engineering, or Infrastructure Implementation.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, LAN/WAN, routing, and switching.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco, HPE, Aruba, or Juniper networking equipment.
* Experience with Fortinet FortiGate or SonicWALL firewalls.
* Knowledge of F5 BIG-IP LTM load balancing and high-availability concepts.
* Experience with BGP, VLANs, STP, VRRP, and inter-VLAN routing.
* Familiarity with RADIUS/ISE, SNMP, SolarWinds, and Wireshark.
* Experience in network deployment, integration testing, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to read network topology diagrams and HLD/LLD documentation.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CCNA certification or equivalent networking knowledge.
* Experience in enterprise network and security infrastructure integration.
* Basic knowledge of Windows and Linux environments.

Skills: integration,routing,firewalls

Surya, being a global player, has a strong clientele spreading across South Asia, Middle East, Africa and North America. title: Solution Test Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
**About the Opportunity:**
At Ericsson, we're shaping the future of connectivity through cutting-edge 5G and cloud-native technologies. We're looking for a Solution Test Engineer to lead end-to-end testing, system integration, automation, and validation of Ericsson Private 5G solutions ( BEWS - Private Networks). In this role, you'll work across 5G Core, RAN, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms, drive quality through automation and CI/CD, troubleshoot complex network issues, and collaborate with global teams to deliver world-class telecom solutions.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Test Design & Execution: Design and execute detailed E2E system test plans for Ericsson Private 5G (EP5G) solutions, ensuring full coverage of 3GPP features and customer use cases.
* System Integration: Integrate and validate 5G components, including Cloud-Native Core (cn5GC), RAN, and Management/Orchestration platforms, ensuring seamless interoperability.
* Advanced Validation: Own the E2E validation for specific feature sets across performance, scaling, and stability, utilizing CI/CD pipelines for automated regression.
* Protocol Debugging: Perform deep-dive troubleshooting of complex call flows using tools like Wireshark/QXDM to analyze NAS/AS signaling and interfaces (N1, N2, N3, etc.).
* Automation Development: Develop and maintain automated test scripts within a Python/Robot Framework environment to increase test velocity and reliability.
* Stability & Performance Testing: Design and run soak tests, stress tests, and load models to identify memory leaks and system bottlenecks before deployment.
* Mentorship: Provide technical guidance to junior engineers, conduct peer reviews of test cases, and contribute to the team's internal knowledge base.

**Skills You Bring**
Bachelor’s/Master’s in CS, EE, or related field with 6–8 years of experience in Telecom/Network testing.
  
  
5G/4G Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of 3GPP architectures and protocols (NGAP, S1AP, RRC, HTTP/2). Ability to analyze multi-interface traces to isolate faults.
  
  
Cloud-Native Skills: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, and Helm. Understanding of K8s networking (Services, Load Balancers, and CNI basics) is essential.
  
  
Networking Foundations: Solid knowledge of L2/L3 networking, including IPV4/V6, VLANs, Routing, and familiarity with OSPF/BGP.
  
  
Automation Proficiency: Strong Python scripting skills and experience with Robot Framework (or similar) to automate complex system-level scenarios.
  
  
System Validation Expertise: Proven ability to design test cases for performance (throughput/latency), scaling, and stability (soak/reliability).
  
  
Infrastructure & Tools: Proficiency in Linux/Unix environments. Experience with industry tools such as Spirent (Landslide), Keysight, or Viavi.
  
  
**“All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.”**

title: IT Infrastructure System Engineer - Linux
description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. Eurofins believes it is a global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.

In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 62,000 staff across a network of more than 1000 independent companies in over 62 countries and operating more than 900 laboratories. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products, as well as providing innovative clinical diagnostic testing services, as one of the leading global emerging players in specialised clinical diagnostics testing.

In 2022, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 6.515 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

**Job Description**

**Job Title: IT Infrastructure System Engineer - Linux
  
  
Job Location: Bangalore
  
  
Work mode: Hybrid (3 days office)
  
  
Shift Timings: 12PM - 9PM**

OVERALL OBJECTIVES: As part of the IT Infrastructure Support Team for Eurofins Food, Feed & Agro Testing Europe, you will join an international team responsible for designing, deploying and operating enterprise Linux platforms across on-premises and Azure environments.
  
  
  
  
The role focuses on Linux systems engineering, automation, virtualization, storage, backup and cloud infrastructure. You will support daily operational activities, troubleshoot complex technical issues, implement infrastructure improvements and deliver strategic transformation projects. The ideal candidate possesses strong Linux administration and automation skills, combined with hands-on experience in Azure, Hyper-V, enterprise storage and backup solutions.
  
  
  
  
This position offers the opportunity to play a key role in Eurofins' ongoing infrastructure modernization initiatives across Europe.

Support and maintain enterprise infrastructure platforms across on-premises and cloud environments.
  
  
Design, implement and improve infrastructure solutions to meet business and operational requirements.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, reliable and scalable IT services.
  
  
Ensure proper documentation, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement of infrastructure services.
  
  
  
  
REQUIRED SKILLS:
  
  
  
  
An ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Linux Systems Engineering and Enterprise Infrastructure Operations:
  
  
  
  
Expert knowledge of Linux operating systems including Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and Ubuntu.
  
  
Strong experience with Linux system administration including package management, systemd, kernel tuning, performance optimization and troubleshooting.
  
  
Experience with Linux security hardening, SELinux, AppArmor, PAM, SSH, auditd and CIS benchmark implementation.
  
  
Advanced troubleshooting skills using system logs, journald, rsyslog, tcpdump, strace, lsof, netstat/ss and performance analysis tools.
  
  
Strong understanding of Linux networking concepts, including routing, DNS, firewalling, VLANs and TCP/IP.
  
  
Experience with Bash & Powershell scripting and automation of operational tasks.
  
  
Experience managing and supporting large-scale production Linux environments.
  
  
Strong understanding of Linux filesystem and storage concepts including LVM, multipathing, NFS and SMB.
  
  
Experience performing OS upgrades, patching, lifecycle management and system recovery activities.
  
  
Ability to diagnose and resolve complex operating system, performance and infrastructure-related issues.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  
  
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multinational environment.
  
  
  
  
  
  
Below skills will be an advantage:
  
  
  
  
Experience with Microsoft Azure administration, including Azure CLI, Azure Automation, Azure Virtual Machines, Networking, Storage Accounts, Private Endpoints, Key Vault and Desired State Configuration (DSC).
  
  
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform & familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**Platform Engineer**

**Role Overview**

* The Platform Engineer will be responsible for designing, automating, and operating UIDAI’s core application and infrastructure platform to ensure high availability, scalability, and reliability across multiple data centres
* This role focuses on Service Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, observability, and infrastructure automation, ensuring that UIDAI systems consistently meet defined SLA/SLO targets
* The position requires in-depth technical expertise in container orchestration, service mesh, CI/CD, monitoring, and distributed system reliability, combined with strong ownership, operational discipline, and collaborative problem-solving skills

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Engineering & Reliability**

* Design and maintain scalable, secure, and fault-tolerant infrastructure for UIDAI’s core systems deployed across multiple DCs
* Apply SRE principles — define, measure, and continuously improve SLIs/SLOs/SLAs for all mission-critical services
* Build self-healing and automated recovery mechanisms for core applications and APIs
* Perform capacity planning, failure testing, and reliability analysis

**Infrastructure Automation & Configuration Management**

* Design and manage infrastructure provisioning and configuration using automation frameworks
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, Ansible, or Chef is desirable
* Develop repeatable automation for environment setup, deployment, and monitoring across hybrid DC environments

**Containerization, Orchestration & Service Mesh**

* Manage and optimise large-scale Kubernetes (K8s) clusters for production workloads
* Implement and maintain Service Mesh (Istio/Linkerd) for secure, observable, and resilient service-to-service communication
* Work with CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and ArgoCD (experience with any equivalent CI/CD platform is acceptable)
* Ensure isolation, policy enforcement, and resource quota management across namespaces and tenants

**Monitoring, Observability & Incident Management**

* Design and maintain the observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and OpenTelemetry)
* Define and monitor SLOs (availability, latency, and error budgets) for all critical services
* Develop automated alerting and runbooks aligned with UIDAI’s reliability goals
* Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Post Incident Reviews (PIR) for continuous improvement

**Collaboration & Governance**

* Collaborate with Product Managers, Architects, and Developers to ensure reliability and performance objectives are integrated into design
* Standardise environments across development, staging, and production
* Participate in architectural reviews and propose platform improvements to enhance scalability, resilience, and efficiency

**Essential**

* B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent discipline from a reputed university
* Minimum 6 years of experience

**Desirable**

* Certifications such as CKA/CKAD, Terraform Associate, AWS/GCP DevOps Engineer, or equivalent
* Recognized SRE/DevOps certifications (Google SRE, Linux Foundation, etc.)

**UIDAI Values**

* Citizen Centricity
* Ownership
* Excellence
* Comfort with Ambiguity

title: Zscaler Network Security-Principal engineer- Associate director
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Security Technology Services – Network Security Technology**
**EY Technology**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently and securely. We have more than 400,000 people in over 150 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to perform their jobs every day.
  
  
Everything we use as a firm depends on our security-first mindset. Our users, applications, cloud platforms, data centers, AI services, and business-critical systems all rely on modern security technologies to enable secure access, protect sensitive information, and reduce cyber risk.
  
  
Within Security Technology Services, our mission is to deliver world-class security engineering capabilities that enable Zero Trust, cloud transformation, attack surface reduction, and secure digital experiences. If you are passionate about building and engineering security solutions at global scale, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a
**Principal Engineer – Associate Director**
to join Security Technology Services as a senior hands-on engineering leader focused on Zscaler, Zero Trust and secure cloud networking integration.
  
  
This role is responsible for engineering, deployment, integration, automation, optimization and technical leadership of EY’s global Zscaler platform and associated network security capabilities.
  
  
The successful candidate will operate as a deeply technical, hands-on subject matter expert across core Zscaler cloud capabilities, ZPA, Zscaler Client Connector, workload segmentation, Azure secure networking concepts, hybrid data center connectivity, Zscaler AI Firewall, AI Guard and Zero Trust access patterns.
  
  
This role will lead strategic engineering initiatives focused on:
  
  

* Azure secure networking integration
* Hybrid cloud security
* VMware data center segmentation
* Enterprise AI security using Zscaler AI Firewall and AI Guard
* Secure access transformation

The role will work closely with Network Security, Cloud Engineering, Application Security, Identity, Infrastructure, Architecture, and Product teams to engineer and deploy scalable enterprise security solutions globally.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
The Zscaler and Zero Trust Engineering Lead will provide senior technical leadership for the deployment, integration, optimization and continuous improvement of EY’s global secure access and Zero Trust engineering platforms.
  
  
**Zscaler Engineering Leadership**

* Serve as the senior hands-on engineering lead for core Zscaler cloud capabilities, including ZIA, ZPA, Zscaler Client Connector, App Connectors, Private Service Edges, Workload Communications, Microsegmentation, Zscaler AI Firewall and AI Guard.
* Engineer, deploy, configure and optimize large-scale Zscaler solutions supporting global business operations.
* Lead onboarding of enterprise applications, cloud services and business workloads into Zero Trust architectures.
* Drive adoption of new Zscaler capabilities and engineering best practices.
* Develop reference configurations, reusable engineering patterns and deployment standards.

**Azure Secure Networking Integration**

* Bring deep working knowledge of Azure secure networking patterns to support Zscaler integration across EY Azure environments.
* Understand, validate and troubleshoot Azure networking components including Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Front Door, Private Link and Private Endpoint.
* Work with EY Azure architects to integrate Zscaler capabilities with Azure-hosted applications, workloads, AI platforms and infrastructure services.
* Translate Azure secure networking requirements into Zscaler engineering patterns, connectivity models and deployment standards.
* Partner closely with EY Azure architecture and cloud engineering teams to drive secure Zscaler product integration across Azure environments.

**Zero Trust and Application Access Engineering**

* Lead migration of applications from traditional VPN and internet-facing architectures to Zero Trust models using ZPA.
* Engineer secure access models for internal users, external users, vendors, contractors and developers.
* Implement identity-aware access controls integrated with Entra ID, Conditional Access and device posture solutions.
* Engineer secure connectivity solutions for hybrid cloud and multi-cloud environments.
* Engineer application segmentation patterns that reduce attack surface and minimize lateral movement risk.

**Workload Segmentation Engineering**

* Implement workload segmentation solutions across Azure and hybrid environments.
* Deploy and manage Zscaler Workload Communications capabilities.
* Engineer workload-to-workload and application-to-application segmentation policies.
* Secure east-west traffic between business-critical applications and services.
* Develop segmentation models for production, non-production, shared services and management environments.

**Data Center and VMware Security Engineering**

* Engineer secure connectivity solutions across traditional data center environments.
* Deploy App Connectors and Private Service Edges in VMware-based infrastructure.
* Integrate Zscaler technologies with enterprise data center environments.
* Support migration of legacy applications into Zero Trust architectures.
* Support secure connectivity integration between on-premises data centers, Zscaler platforms and Azure cloud environments.

**Engineering Automation and Platform Optimization**

* Build and maintain automation solutions to improve security engineering efficiency.
* Automate deployment, configuration validation and policy management activities.
* Utilize Terraform, Python, PowerShell, APIs and Infrastructure-as-Code approaches.
* Improve platform scalability, consistency and operational effectiveness through automation.
* Participate in development of future-state security engineering roadmaps.

**Technical Leadership**

* Serve as the highest level engineering escalation point for complex technical issues.
* Lead troubleshooting of networking, routing, DNS, TLS, authentication and connectivity challenges.
* Mentor and coach engineers across Network Security Technology.
* Participate in architecture reviews, engineering governance and major transformation programs.
* Communicate complex technical concepts to engineering, architecture and executive stakeholders.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
We are interested in candidates who bring deep engineering experience from large global enterprise environments and can combine hands-on technical execution with practical leadership.
  
  
As a successful candidate, you will demonstrate:
  
  

* Strong hands-on engineering expertise across network security, cloud security and Zero Trust technologies.
* Deep troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to engineer and deploy security solutions at enterprise scale in partnership with platform architecture teams.
* Strong understanding of Azure secure networking, hybrid connectivity and cloud security integration patterns.
* Experience working across global teams and multiple technology disciplines.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Passion for automation, innovation and continuous improvement.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced and highly complex environments.

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent experience.
* 15-20 years of Network Security and Security Engineering experience.
* 12-15 years of experience engineering, deploying or integrating cloud security and Zscaler technologies.
* 8-10 years leading engineering teams or large engineering initiatives.
* Expert-level experience with Zscaler technologies including ZIA and ZPA.
* Experience deploying and supporting enterprise-scale Zscaler environments.
* Experience implementing Zero Trust solutions and secure access architectures.
* Experience onboarding cloud-hosted and on-premises applications into ZPA.
* Experience supporting and troubleshooting Azure secure networking environments in partnership with Azure architecture teams.
* Experience deploying security solutions within VMware-based data centers.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, routing, BGP, PKI and enterprise networking concepts.
* Experience with automation technologies such as Python, Terraform, PowerShell and REST APIs.
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Deep expertise in Azure Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall Premium, Application Gateway, Front Door and Private Link.
* Experience deploying Zscaler Workload Communications and workload segmentation solutions.
* Experience reducing public IP exposure through Zero Trust architectures.
* Experience securing Azure IaaS, PaaS and AKS environments.
* Experience integrating Zscaler with Microsoft Entra ID and Conditional Access.
* Strong understanding of SASE and SSE security architectures.
* Experience securing AI, GenAI and cloud-native workloads using Zscaler AI Firewall and AI Guard.
* Zscaler Certifications focused on ZIA, ZPA, Client Connector, workload segmentation, AI Firewall, AI Guard or equivalent hands-on platform engineering credentials.
* Azure Network Engineer Associate or Azure Security Engineer certifications.
* CISSP, CCSP, CCNP or equivalent certifications.

**What We Look For**
We are looking for a highly technical engineering leader who remains hands-on, leads by example and is comfortable solving complex security challenges across global cloud, data center and Zero Trust environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate has successfully integrated and deployed Zscaler technologies across Azure, enterprise data centers, and hybrid cloud environments, possesses deep networking expertise, and can engineer scalable Zero Trust solutions in partnership with EY Azure architects and platform teams.
  
  
**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working, career development and benefits that support your personal and professional priorities.
  
  
Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from engaging colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
* Exposure to large-scale global technology and cybersecurity transformation programs.
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you.

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service while supporting your career and personal priorities.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Develop troubleshooting playbooks and deliver advanced technical training on Prisma AIRS and Cloud NGFW architecture.

**Required Qualifications**

* Solid grasp of AWS, Azure, and GCP networking constructs and fundamentals in TCP/IP, IPv6, and dynamic routing.
* Expertise in troubleshooting, API integrations, routing/switching, IPSec, SSL/TLS, and packet analysis using tcpdump and Wireshark.
* Proficiency with Python, REST APIs, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) to automate lab deployments and scripts.
* Strong communication skills to deliver highly technical presentations to Engineers and Executive teams.
* Ability and willingness to work flexible hours, including occasional weekends, evenings, and rotating on-call shifts.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficiency with state-of-the-art AI models such as Claude and ChatGPT in coding and engineering workflows.
* Comfortable navigating Linux shells, understanding sockets, and monitoring resource consumption.
* Deep understanding of PAN-OS architecture, specifically dataplane packet flow, App-ID, Content-ID, and SSL Decryption.
* Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks products, particularly Prisma AIRS.
* Experience with incident management tools such as PagerDuty or FireHydrant.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Staff Cloud Infra Engineer
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
  
  
Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
  
  
At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
  
  
When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
  
  
**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office.*
**About The Role**
You'll own a significant area of our cloud platform end to end — the Kubernetes and IaC foundations, the reliability of what runs on them, or the security controls that wrap them — across cloud regions and out to edge sites co-located with our satellite gateways.
  
  
At Staff level we expect you to take a problem that's stated loosely, turn it into a plan, and deliver it without close supervision. You'll write the design doc, get it reviewed, build the thing, and then operate it. You're not expected to set direction for the whole org — but you are expected to shape it for your area, and to be the person others come to when that area is on fire. This is a hands-on role. The majority of your week is building.
  
  
What you'll own
  
  
**Platform and Kubernetes**

* Operate and improve our multi-cluster, multi-region Kubernetes platform: cluster lifecycle, upgrades, workload isolation, networking, and resource management.
* Build and maintain infrastructure as code as a real engineering artifact — reviewed, tested, versioned, no manual drift.
* Extend our developer platform so shipping a service is fast and boring: golden paths, progressive delivery, environments that don't require a ticket.
* Own CI/CD pipelines for workloads ranging from ordinary stateless services to network functions with strict latency and availability requirements.

**Reliability and observability**

* Instrument services against SLOs and build out the metrics, logs, and tracing needed to know whether we're meeting them.
* Participate in on-call, lead incidents in your area, and write postmortems that produce real changes rather than filed documents.
* Tune alerting so engineers trust it. Drive down toil through automation, deliberately and measurably.
* Contribute to capacity planning, failure-domain design, and DR testing for a network that can't take a casual maintenance window.

**Security and compliance infrastructure**

* Implement and maintain platform security controls: least-privilege IAM, secrets management, network segmentation, image scanning, and supply-chain integrity.
* Automate the evidence that compliance requires, so audits are a query rather than a project.
* Work with Security on the requirements that come with operating inside a carrier's network.

**Technical contribution**

* Write design docs for the systems you own and take them through review.
* Review code and infrastructure changes with an eye on operability, not just correctness.
* Mentor mid-level engineers and improve the team's practices by demonstrating them.

What we're looking for
  
  
**Required**

* 7+ years in infrastructure, platform, DevOps, or SRE roles, with clear ownership of production systems that mattered.
* Strong production Kubernetes experience — not just deploying to it, but operating it: upgrades, networking, resource limits, and debugging failures that aren't in the documentation.
* Hands-on depth in AWS or GCP. Exposure to a second cloud, or to hybrid and edge infrastructure, is a real plus — our footprint isn't uniform and we need people who don't stall when the environment gets irregular.
* Solid infrastructure as code practice (Terraform or equivalent), applied where discipline actually mattered.
* Proficiency in at least one systems or automation language — Go or Python preferred — enough to build tooling, not only scripts.
* Direct production reliability ownership: you've carried a pager for something important, run incidents, and changed systems as a result.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure security: IAM, secrets, network policy, container hardening.
* Clear written communication. Design docs and postmortems are core to how this team works.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Telecom or network infrastructure exposure — 5G core, cloud-native network functions, or carrier-grade availability requirements.
* Have some experience in managing databases and applications with High Availability of 99.999%.
* Edge or on-premises infrastructure alongside public cloud, particularly sites with constrained connectivity.
* Compliance-adjacent environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or carrier security requirements).
* FinOps Cost engineering — you've meaningfully reduced cloud spend without degrading reliability.
* Working across distributed teams and time zones.

**What This Role Is Not**

* Not a people-management role. This is an IC position and we intend to keep it one.
* Not a ticket queue. You'll be given problems, not tasks, and we expect you to scope them yourself.
* Not a greenfield rewrite. You'll be improving a system already carrying live traffic, which is harder and more interesting.

Why this role is worth your time
  
  
Satellite direct-to-device is a genuinely new category, and the infrastructure patterns for it are not settled. The team is small enough that what you build is in production within weeks and visibly yours. If you're strong technically and looking for scope that would take years to get at a larger company, that's the trade we're offering.
  
  
**What We Offer**
With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range of benefits such as:
  
  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive benefits plans
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to be part of developing and running the world’s first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service
* Access to a world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics

**EEO Statement**
Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

title: Systems Administrator, Hybrid Cloud and AI Infrastructure
description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
  
  
Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).
  
  
This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
Lenovo seeks a Systems Administrator to own end-to-end deployment, support, and administration of hybrid cloud and AI infrastructure primarily for the Bangalore lab, across the network, compute, storage, operating system, and container orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes) layers, plus the NVIDIA technology stack.
  
  
You are a dedicated support resource for the Lab Operations Manager and you keep hybrid cloud and AI infrastructure operational in Bangalore at the scale the AI Lab Consolidation requires. You coordinate remotely with the Morrisville-based Systems Administrator, GPU/AI Infrastructure, Network Engineer on shared standards, escalations, and cross-site incident response, and you provide secondary technical support back to Morrisville. The role sits within Lenovo SSG’s Hybrid Cloud and AI Infrastructure Services (HCAIS) Offering Architecture Engineering organization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Infrastructure Deployment and Administration
  
  

* Network: deploy, support, and administer lab networking for the Bangalore site.
* Compute: deploy, support, and administer physical and virtual compute infrastructure across the Bangalore lab.
* Storage: deploy, support, and administer lab storage systems across block and file tiers.
* Operating Systems: install, patch, and administer operating systems across Bangalore lab infrastructure.

Hybrid Cloud Platform Administration
  
  

* VMware: deploy, support, and administer VMware virtualization infrastructure (vSphere, ESXi, vCenter).
* Azure: support hybrid cloud integration and workloads extending Bangalore lab infrastructure to Microsoft Azure.
* Nutanix: deploy, support, and administer Nutanix hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI).
* Red Hat OpenShift: deploy, support, and administer Red Hat OpenShift container platform environments, extending the lab’s container orchestration footprint.

Container Orchestration
  
  

* Docker: deploy and administer Docker container runtime environments.
* Kubernetes: own full production Kubernetes administration, including cluster operations, role-based access control (RBAC), cluster networking, and version upgrades.

NVIDIA Platform Administration
  
  

* NVIDIA Technology Stack: administer NVIDIA drivers, the CUDA toolkit, InfiniBand fabric, Run:AI orchestration, and ClearML across the Bangalore lab’s GPU infrastructure.
* Configuration Validation: validate lab configurations against NVIDIA reference architecture (Lenovo Validated Design) certification requirements.

Lab Operations and Smart Hands
  
  

* Equipment Support: provide on-site, hands-on technical support for capital equipment requested by the Bangalore Professional Services / LMS team.
* Day-to-Day Support: provide day-to-day administration, support, and engineering functions for the network, compute, and storage layers in the physical Bangalore lab.
* Rack and Stack: perform rack-and-stack, structured cabling, imaging, and smart-hands support for lab hardware alongside higher-level administration duties.

Cross-Site Support and Coordination
  
  

* Morrisville Secondary Support: provide secondary technical support for NVIDIA technology stack capital equipment hosted in Morrisville.
* Remote Coordination: coordinate remotely with the Morrisville-based Systems Administrator, GPU/AI Infrastructure, Network Engineer, and Junior Systems Administrator on shared standards, escalations, and incident response across a roughly 12-hour time zone gap.
* NVIDIA Relationship: maintain a working relationship with NVIDIA field contacts, coordinating remotely with the Morrisville-based team.

**Required Qualifications**
Required Experience
  
  

* 4+ years of systems administration experience with hands-on breadth across network, compute, storage, and operating system layers, plus a GPU/AI infrastructure specialization.
* Hybrid Cloud Platforms: hands-on experience with hybrid cloud platforms such as VMware (vSphere/ESXi/vCenter), Microsoft Azure, Nutanix HCI, or Red Hat OpenShift.
* Hybrid Cloud or AI Certification: NVIDIA NCP-AI or equivalent in Microsoft or Red Hat OpenShift.
* Production Kubernetes Administration: demonstrated experience with cluster operations, RBAC, cluster networking, and version upgrades in a production environment.
* Docker: hands-on experience administering Docker container runtime environments.
* Hands-on NVIDIA administration: demonstrated experience administering NVIDIA drivers and the CUDA toolkit.
* Physical Infrastructure: comfortable with hands-on hardware work, including rack-and-stack, structured cabling, and smart hands, in addition to higher-level administration.

Core Professional Skills
  
  

* Incident Response: able to own after-hours incident response for a shared, multi-team infrastructure environment.
* Independent Ownership: comfortable working as the senior on-site infrastructure owner in Bangalore, remotely coordinating with the Morrisville-based team across a significant time zone gap.
* Physical Presence: this role requires physical, on-site presence in Bangalore and cannot be performed remotely from elsewhere.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Multi-Tenant Lab Experience: experience supporting a multi-tenant shared lab environment serving distributed teams.
* Experience with DCIM, IPAM, or monitoring tooling comparable to the lab’s stack (Hyperview-class DCIM, BlueCat / Infoblox-class IPAM, NVIDIA DCGM monitoring).
* InfiniBand Fabric: working familiarity with InfiniBand fabric in a multi-node GPU environment.
* GPU Orchestration: experience with Run:AI, ClearML, or a comparable GPU orchestration and MLOps toolset.

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.*

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 15+ years of software engineering experience with significant depth in networking/traffic engineering, distributed systems, and/or cyber security.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Go (Java acceptable/valuable for specific subsystems); experience building production-grade, high-performance systems.
* Deep knowledge of Linux networking, traffic management fundamentals, and systems performance optimization.
* Strong experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure at scale.
* Proven experience designing secure, scalable, observable distributed platforms and operating them in production.
* Demonstrated cross-team technical leadership: driving architecture across multiple systems, influencing partners, and delivering large initiatives.
* Strong communication, mentoring, and technical decision-making skills in ambiguous environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Envoy, service mesh, control plane/data plane architectures, NGINX/HAProxy, SDN, eBPF, or comparable technologies.

* Background in PoP design, caching strategies, and internet-scale traffic optimization.
* Vendor tool integration experience and operation in globally distributed environments.
* Open-source contributions, patents, or externally visible technical leadership.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Improved global traffic platform outcomes (latency, throughput, availability, resilience, security).
* Reduced incident frequency/impact through architecture, observability, and operational rigor.
* Strong architectural alignment across teams with higher engineering quality and execution velocity.

title: Senior System Administrator
description:

BigEndian Semiconductors is a fabless semiconductor startup developing secure, high-performance System-on-Chips (SoCs) in India for global markets. The company builds silicon platforms that power next-generation surveillance, telecom, IoT, and enterprise systems, guided by a “security by design” philosophy that tightly integrates hardware and software. With deep expertise in VLSI, system architecture, and embedded software, BigEndian focuses on trusted solutions for both national security and commercial applications. Headquartered in Bengaluru and supported by strategic partnerships in Taiwan and India, the company is backed by leaders with decades of experience at Intel, ARM, Broadcom, and Zenoti, along with government programs and deep-tech investors. BigEndian is committed to helping India become a global hub for semiconductor design, innovation, and manufacturing, starting with fabless and progressing toward full-scale fabrication capabilities.

**Role Description**
The Senior System Administrator is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru, responsible for maintaining and optimizing the company’s IT and infrastructure systems. This role includes installing, configuring, and monitoring servers, networks, and related hardware and software to ensure high availability, performance, and security. The Senior System Administrator will manage user accounts, access controls, and backup and recovery processes, while proactively identifying and resolving system issues. Daily responsibilities also involve collaborating with engineering and operations teams, implementing security best practices, supporting development environments, and coordinating with vendors and partners for infrastructure-related needs. The individual in this role will document procedures, contribute to process improvements, and help scale systems as the company grows.

* Solid experience in managing the On Prim/local and cloud server
* Experience implementing security controls, patch management, and compliance-related configurations in enterprise environments.
* Ability to script or automate routine tasks using tools such as Bash, PowerShell, or Python.
* Excellent documentation, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., RHCE, CCNA, CompTIA Security+) are an advantage.

Cloud SRE team to champion automation to enhance efficiency and reliability.

**Position Summary**
Join Deloitte Cyber to help clients strengthen technology resilience and recovery capabilities across complex enterprise environments. As a Senior Consultant, you will support clients in identifying resilience risks, designing recovery strategies, and implementing solutions that improve preparedness for cyber incidents, operational disruptions, and technology failures. You will work across infrastructure, cloud, backup, and recovery domains to help organizations improve operational continuity and recovery readiness.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Defense & Resilience team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Conduct technology resilience risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities, technical risks, and single points of failure across enterprise environments
* Design and implement cyber resilience, disaster recovery, incident response, and business continuity solutions aligned to client requirements
* Design, build, and maintain isolated recovery environments and support recovery of critical workloads, including applications, databases, and directory services
* Assess infrastructure, application, network, storage, and cloud environments to improve resilience architecture, backup integrity, and recovery readiness
* Lead recovery testing, simulation exercises, runbook development, and client preparedness activities across resilience programs

**The team**
Cyber Defense & Resilience teams help clients defend against sophisticated threats by transforming security operations, leveraging technology, data analytics, and threat intelligence for continuous monitoring and rapid incident response. They manage dynamic attack surfaces and support business continuity through services such as operational resilience, crisis and incident response, and security operations center transformation.
  
  
Resilience as a Practice focuses on preparing organizations to anticipate, withstand, and recover from disruptions—including cyberattacks, natural disasters, and operational failures—by embedding resilience into processes, technology, and culture. Deloitte’s Resilience Team combines technical, operational, and strategic expertise to deliver integrated solutions for business continuity, disaster recovery, and risk management, ensuring organizations meet regulatory demands and maintain stakeholder trust during crises.

description:

What You Can Expect
  
  
The Network & Security Sr Engineer is responsible for design, implementation, security, and operation of the organization’s enterprise network and network security infrastructure. Hybrid (3 days in office)

* Manage incidents, service requests, and change requests through ServiceNow.

* Ensure adherence to SLAs, operational procedures, and escalation processes.

* Secure Service Edge (SSE)

* Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) and SASE/SSE
* Identity & Access Management (Entra ID, SAML, MFA, SSO)

* DNS Security, URL Filtering, and Threat Prevention
* Security Incident Investigation and Troubleshooting

**Networking Fundamentals**

* Routing and Switching Concepts
* BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLANs
* GRE and IPSec Tunnels
* Proxy Technologies
* VPN Concepts
* Load Balancer (Citrix)

**Monitoring & Operations**

* ServiceNow
* Grafana
* SolarWinds
* Network Monitoring & Packet Analysis Tools

**Automation**

* Ansible

title: Senior CDN Engineer

Senior CDN & Edge Security Engineer (Akamai)

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior CDN & Edge Security Operations Specialist with deep expertise in Akamai

technologies to manage, optimize, and secure traffic for high-throughput Media and mission-critical

Fintech platforms. In this role, you will lead the configuration, daily performance monitoring, edge

security enforcement (WAF/DDoS), and incident troubleshooting across our global edge

infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

● Traffic & Cache Management: Design, configure, and maintain Akamai edge configurations

(Property Manager, Edge DNS, GTM) to optimize HTTP/S cache ratios, lower origin load,

and maximize reliability across microservices and API gateways.

● WAF & DDoS Mitigation: Configure and tune Akamai security modules (App and Api

protector, Web Application Protector, Bot Manager) to defend APIs and web applications

against zero-day threats, automated bot attacks, and volumetric DDoS incidents.

streaming) using Akamai Adaptive Media Delivery (AMD) and Media Services Live to ensure

platform ecosystem.

networks.

(e.g., Terraform Akamai Provider) for edge deployments.

analytics.

*This position will be on-site reporting to our Bangalore office, M-F.*
*This team provides 24/7 support. This role requires shift flexibility, including the ability to rotate between days, mids, and nights.*
The Principal Engineer will be responsible for creation of procedures, implementation of processes and development of staff for managing and maintaining security systems across internal and client environments. The Principal Engineer will work closely with Management, Senior Engineers, Solution Architects, Senior Security Engineers, other Principal Security Engineers and clients to complete high profile, critical services to existing Managed Security Service clients. Serve as a subject matter expert and team lead, staying in tune with all client configuration issues and all internal projects.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Lead the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of enterprise PKI solutions using Venafi as the primary tool, along with KeyFactor and Sectigo.
* Architect and manage certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, and automation across hybrid environments.
* Collaborate with security, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure seamless integration of PKI services.
* Provide technical leadership in PKI strategy, governance, and compliance.
* Drive automation and scalability of certificate management processes.
* Conduct root cause analysis and remediation for PKI-related incidents.
* Evaluate and test new PKI technologies and upgrades.
* Maintain detailed documentation for PKI architecture, configurations, and operational procedures.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of hands-on experience in PKI management, with deep expertise in Venafi and Sectigo
* Strong understanding of certificate lifecycle management, cryptographic protocols, and identity-based security.
* Experience with KeyFactor, Sectigo, and other PKI platforms is a plus.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based certificate management.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CCSK are preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Proven track record of delivering secure and scalable PKI solutions.
* Understanding of network architecture and implementation is a must; ideal candidate will have worked with network security analysis.
* Excellent time management, reporting, and communication skills.
* Superior IT problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of Linux and Windows Operating Systems
* An understanding of a wide array of server grade applications such as: DBMS, Exchange, DNS, SMTP, IIS, Apache, SharePoint, Active Directory, Identity Management, Patch Management, LDAP, SQL, and others
* Hands-on experience with automation using REST APIs and scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash)
* This role demands the availability during US working hours 5 PM (IST) to 2 AM (IST)
* This role is a Work from Office role.

**What You Can Expect From Optiv**

* A company committed to our inclusive value through our Employee Resource Groups
* Work/life balance
* Professional training resources
* Creative problem-solving and the ability to tackle unique, complex projects
* Volunteer Opportunities. “Optiv Chips In” encourages employees to volunteer and engage with their teams and communities.
* The ability and technology necessary to productively work remotely/from home (where applicable)

title: NCX Senior Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is hiring an NCX Senior Engineer who is passionate about NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) infrastructure operations to join our DSX team. This role involves working closely with strategic NVIDIA Cloud Partners to build and improve the operational capabilities essential for running large-scale NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure reliably in production.
  
  
Your role involves guiding partners beyond the initial cluster deployment and validation phase into advanced Day 2 operations. These operations cover ongoing infrastructure health, observability, lifecycle management, quick remediation, performance validation, and operational readiness. You will engage directly with partner engineering and operations teams to develop consistent approaches that support NVIDIA workloads and the broader external customer environments of the partners. This is a highly technical, hands-on role at the intersection of NVIDIA accelerated computing, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and production operations.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead NCP Day 2 operational readiness efforts. Collaborate directly with NVIDIA Cloud Partners to set up the systems, procedures, automation, and operational methods necessary to consistently manage NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure following initial deployment and activation.
* Build continuous infrastructure validation. Develop and implement methods to continuously validate GPU, CPU, storage, and network health. Do this across large-scale AI clusters to identify degraded infrastructure before it impacts critical training or inference workloads.
* Establish observability and operational telemetry. Help NCPs implement comprehensive telemetry, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and operational signals across compute, GPU, InfiniBand/RoCE networking, storage, Kubernetes, and AI workloads.
* Develop automated detection and remediation. Build workflows to detect, isolate, drain, repair, validate, and return unhealthy infrastructure to service while minimizing disruption to customer workloads.
* Refine fleet lifecycle administration. Implement scalable strategies for managing sizable GPU fleets, including NVIDIA driver and firmware lifecycle administration, Kubernetes node maintenance, OS patching, configuration management, upgrades, and configuration drift identification.
* Operationalize NVIDIA reference architectures. Translate NVIDIA NCP requirements and reference architectures into production operating practices, validation criteria, runbooks, automation, and measurable operational standards.
* Define operational health and readiness. Develop health signals, SLOs, important metrics, acceptance criteria, and ongoing validation mechanisms that provide NVIDIA and NCPs with clear insight into infrastructure reliability and service readiness.
* Build reusable operational frameworks. Develop tooling, automation, implementation guides, runbooks, operational playbooks, and reference implementations that can be applied consistently across multiple NCP environments.

**What We Need To See**

* BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, cloud platform engineering, systems engineering, or similar roles supporting large-scale production environments.
* Strong experience operating Linux-based distributed systems and cloud infrastructure in production.
* Deep understanding of Kubernetes, containers, cluster scheduling, and the operational lifecycle of large multi-node environments.
* Strong understanding of production observability, including metrics, logging, alerting, dashboards, health checks, and operations guided by service level agreements.
* Experience crafting automation for infrastructure lifecycle management, failure detection, remediation, upgrades, and configuration management.
* Strong networking fundamentals and experience troubleshooting complex distributed systems across compute, network, and storage layers.
* Programming and automation experience using Python, Go, shell scripting, or similar languages.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience managing extensive GPU or accelerated computing infrastructure that supports AI training and inference workloads.
* Experience with NVIDIA technologies including DGX/HGX systems, CUDA, NVLink/NVSwitch, NVIDIA networking, InfiniBand, RoCE, GPU Operator, Network Operator, or related NVIDIA infrastructure software.
* Proven experience collaborating with NVIDIA Cloud Partners, hyperscale cloud providers, managed AI clouds, or extensive service-provider infrastructure and operating SLOs for large-scale compute infrastructure and using operational data to improve availability, performance, and fleet efficiency.
* Extensive knowledge of infrastructure observability tools including Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Alertmanager, and scalable telemetry pipelines and translating reference architectures or infrastructure requirements into repeatable production operating models across multiple customer or partner environments.
* Knowledge of failure modes related to large distributed AI workloads and the infrastructure features necessary to consistently support extended training and production inference.

NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for phenomenal people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and dedicated people in the world working for us.

title: Infrastructure Engineer III
description:
**Job Description**
Responsible for contacting clients with overdue accounts to secure the settlement of the account. Also they do preventive work to avoid future overdues with accounts that have a high exposure.
  
  
The VMware Operations team is part of Cloud Operations and provides 24x7x365 management and Support for American Express Enterprise VMware Virtual Infrastructure. * Handling of routine mundane tasks using PowerShell, PowerCLI, Python, Ansible and such automation tools/engines.
* Troubleshooting and Upgrade of VMware, Nutanix & UCS Components & hands on experience using command line on all platforms. Good troubleshooting skills and experience on log analysis.
* Builds, deploys, maintain and assist with repairs of VMware servers/hosts on racks, blades, and hyper converged infrastructures.
* Troubleshooting Hardware and Operating system related issues.

* Minimum 6+ years proven experience of managing large enterprise level VMware Environment.

* Working understanding of SAN, NAS, NFS, VMFS, iSCSI.
* Experience in VMware Guests, Templates, P2V, Capacity Planner, VMotion, HA, DRS, etc.
* Good Understanding of Virtual infrastructure security Hardening & compliance including certificates for the overall virtualized environment.
* Experience on Dell, Intel, Cisco, HP Servers and associated management tools like, Dell OME/SAE, HP OneView.
* Basic understanding on cloud service platforms and concepts around the same.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science/Management Information Systems or equivalent experience preferred.

title: Director – Technical Major Incident Manager
description:
**FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India), a part of First Citizens BancShares, Inc., a top 20 U.S. financial institution, is a global capability center (GCC) based in Bengaluru. Our India-based teams benefit from the company’s over 125-year legacy of strength and stability. First Citizens India is responsible for delivering value and managing risks for our lines of business. We are particularly proud of our strong, relationship-driven culture and our long-term approach, which are deeply ingrained in our talented workforce. This is evident across all key areas of our operations, including Technology, Enterprise Operations, Finance, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Credit Administration. We are seeking talented individuals to join us in our mission of providing solutions fit for our clients’ greatest ambitions.**
**Job Description**
**Value Proposition**

* The Director, Infrastructure Engineering - Technical Major Incident Manager serves as the senior technical authority responsible for leading the response, coordination and resolution of critical technology incidents across the enterprise. Operating as an Individual Contributor, the role drives rapid service restoration, incident command, technical escalation management, root cause elimination, operational resilience and service reliability improvements across infrastructure, cloud, and application ecosystems.
* Working closely with Infrastructure Operations, Server, Virtualization, Unix, Network, Database, Storage, Backup, Container platform, Security, Application Support and Vendor teams. The role drives operational excellence, incident response maturity, governance, stakeholder engagement, and service reliability across the enterprise technology landscape
* The position partners with Engineering, Infrastructure, SRE, Application Support, Cybersecurity and Vendor teams to minimize business impact during major incidents, improve incident response effectiveness and prevent recurring service disruptions through continuous improvement and reliability engineering practices

Career Level: P6
  
  
Job Category: Director (Individual Contributor)
  
  
Role Type: Hybrid
  
  
Job Location: Bangalore

* Facilitate post-incident reviews and corrective action tracking

Although operating as an Individual Contributor, this role serves as a senior technical leader across the organization

* Drive technical communities of practice

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Lead strategic programs through influence

title: 4LS Support Lead
description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for an experienced 4LS Support Lead with 12+ years of experience supporting cloud-native, distributed, and observability applications in mission-critical production environments. The role requires very good expertise in advanced troubleshooting across applications, microservices, Kubernetes platforms, infrastructure, networking, databases, and observability stacks, with the ability to lead critical incident recovery, perform deep Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and drive corrective and preventive actions as the highest technical escalation point. The role requires participation in a 24x7 rotational shift model supporting global customer deployments and critical escalations.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Lead L4 support operations for cloud-native observability applications and distributed systems, ensuring high availability, reliability, and operational excellence across production environments.
* Drive resolution of complex production incidents, lead service recovery efforts, and leverage AI-assisted troubleshooting and analytics tools to accelerate diagnosis, impact assessment, and restoration of services.
* Lead deep root cause analysis (RCA) investigations for critical incidents and recurring issues, driving corrective and preventive actions to improve platform stability, resilience, and customer experience.
* Utilize advanced expertise across OAM/FCAPS, Kubernetes, microservices, infrastructure, networking, databases, and observability platforms to diagnose and resolve complex technical challenges.
* Serve as the highest technical escalation point for customer-critical incidents, providing technical leadership and coordination across Engineering, L2/L3 Support, and customer teams.
* Drive continuous improvements in monitoring, troubleshooting methodologies, automation, operational processes, and AI-enabled support practices to enhance operational efficiency and reduce incident recurrence.
* Participate in a 24x7 rotational support organization, ensuring SLA compliance, continuous service availability, and effective management of critical incidents and escalations across global customer deployments.

**Key Skills And Experience**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree with 12+ years of experience in production support, incident management, and technical leadership for large-scale cloud-native and distributed systems.
* Hands-on expertise in Kubernetes/OpenShift, microservices, Linux, and containerized application platforms, including troubleshooting complex issues across application, platform, and infrastructure layers.
* Proven experience in Root Cause Analysis (RCA), performance troubleshooting, service recovery, and resolution of critical production incidents, with the ability to act as the highest technical escalation point for customer-critical issues.
* Deep knowledge of OAM/FCAPS and observability technologies, including fault and performance management, metrics, logs, traces, monitoring, alerting, and operational analytics, along with cross-functional collaboration and SLA management.

title: Senior Manager, Cyber Technology Consulting

Kroll is seeking a Senior Manager, OT Security Architect to support and grow its Operational Technology Security business from India. This role will serve as a senior technical and delivery leader for OT Security engagements, providing offshore architecture, advisory, implementation, and delivery support for projects across EMEA and North America.
  
  
The role will be responsible for assessing OT security risks, designing secure OT architectures, supporting implementation of security controls, and helping clients improve the resilience of their industrial control systems and critical operations. **Day-to-Day Responsibilities**

* Prepare clear technical reports, executive summaries, architecture diagrams, and client recommendations.
* Work with Kroll teams across EMEA, North America, and India to provide offshore delivery support for OT Security projects.
* Coordinate with Kroll delivery teams, offensive security, MDR, DFIR, and cyber advisory practices to support integrated OT security engagements.
* Collaborate with OT security technology partners and vendors during solution design, Proofs of Concept, tool implementation, and client delivery.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute to the development of OT Security methods, templates, and delivery accelerators.

**Essential Traits**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, GICSP) are preferred.
* OT Security focused certifications preferred (GICSP, GRID, ISA/IEC 62443 Series etc)
* Minimum of 7 years of experience in cybersecurity.
* Deep understanding of OT Security standards such as ISA/IEC 62443, NIST 800-82, etc.
* Proficiency using OT-specific security tools and frameworks such as Nozomi Networks, Tenable, Armis etc for threat detection and response in Industrial Control Systems (ICS)

* Required hands-on experience with at least one major OT security monitoring platform, preferably Nozomi Networks or Claroty
* Experience with security technologies relevant to enterprise and OT environments.
* Proficiency in network security, threat analysis, and risk assessment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

* Comfortable working across time zones with clients, internal stakeholders, and technology partners.

title: IT Administrator (2-3 years exp, IT Infrastructure, Endpoint & Security)
description:
**Job Title : IT Administrator**

  -
*IT Infrastructure, Endpoint & Security | Bengaluru (On-site)*

 

**Company Description**

 

Inkers Technology is based in Bengaluru with offices in the USA and UAE. We specialise in designing and developing deep, large-scale AI and ML solutions for the construction industry. With a focus on AI, computer vision, and deep neural networks, we have extended our capabilities into the construction industry with our innovative AI-powered construction management solution, “Kaël” — an AI project manager that predicts delays, flags risks, automates reporting, and prevents cost overruns with real-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform, “Observance”, uses LiDAR scanning, thermal imaging, and AI-powered analysis to deliver BIM models, deviation detection, and as-built intelligence. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of technology across diverse sectors.

 

**Role Description**

 

We are looking for a Senior IT Administrator to own day-to-day IT operations while building out a more mature infrastructure, identity, endpoint, and security backbone as Inkers scales. This role goes beyond frontline support — you will administer Microsoft 365 and endpoint/MDM environments end-to-end, strengthen identity and access management, support cloud administration across AWS/Azure, and bring structure to IT security and compliance practices. You will also mentor and support junior IT staff and act as the go-to escalation point for complex issues.

 

The candidate should be willing to travel to project sites and work in the field whenever required, including supporting 3D scanning equipment and on-site IT requirements.

 

**This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru.**

 

**Responsibilities**

 

* Own Microsoft 365 administration — Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and OneDrive — including licensing, mail flow, retention policies, and PowerShell-driven automation.
* Lead identity and access management across Active Directory, Group Policy, and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including user provisioning/deprovisioning, security groups, MFA, and Conditional Access.
* Administer endpoint and MDM environments (Microsoft Intune, Jamf Pro, or equivalent) across Windows, macOS, and iOS — device enrollment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and app deployment.
* Provide IT support to employees for hardware, software, network, email, and system-related issues, and set up/configure laptops, desktops, monitors, printers, and other equipment.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows and Linux systems.
* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, switches, routers, and other network issues; support enterprise networking (e.g. Cisco Meraki) where applicable.
* Assist with AWS/Azure cloud monitoring, administration, and cost/performance optimisation.
* Maintain IT asset records, software licenses, and equipment inventories; maintain IT documentation, SOPs, and troubleshooting records.
* Perform system updates, antivirus/EDR checks, backups, and other security activities; support ISO 27001-aligned security and audit practices.
* Support CCTV, NVR, access-control systems, and other office/site IT infrastructure.
* Coordinate with vendors for internet, hardware, software, AMC, and other IT services.
* Own employee onboarding and offboarding, including system setup and access management.
* Track IT issues end-to-end and ensure timely resolution; act as the Level 2/3 escalation point for the IT function.
* Travel to project sites when required for 3D scanning, scanning equipment setup, and on-site IT support.

**Qualifications**

 

* 2-3 years of experience in IT Administration, IT Support, or System Administration.
* Degree/Diploma in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux systems, plus computer hardware, networking, and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace administration.
* Working knowledge of AWS/Azure or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with MDM/endpoint management (Intune, Jamf, or similar) is a strong plus.
* Exposure to information security practices and frameworks (e.g. ISO 27001) is a plus.
* Good communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and handle multiple IT requirements.
* Willingness to travel and work at project sites when required.
