title: Linux System and Hardware Administrator
description:
**General Information**
**Job Title:**
Linux System and Hardware Administrator
  
  
**Primary Job Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
  
  
**Location Flexibility:**
Hybrid, Bengaluru based (minimum 3 days a week in office)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Permanent, Full-Time
  
  
**Hiring Timeline (Hiring month):**
Immediate
  
  
**Reporting Line:**
Head of Corporate Technology
  
  
**Application Deadline:**
Open until filled
  
  
**Notice Period:**
30 days or less preferred, 60 days maximum
  
  
**Existing Vacancy:**
Yes
  
  
**Application Deadline:**
Open until Filled
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
2:00 PM - 11:00 PM IST
  
  
**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):**
Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.
  
  
We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.
  
  
Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.
  
  
**Role Overview:**
The Linux System and Hardware Administrator is the hands-on owner of day-to-day operations for Fulfillment IQ's Linux servers and for the laptops and hardware used by our India-based team. The role sits in the Corporate Technology team within FIQ Group Shared Services, which supports both our services and product businesses. You will run routine server administration, set up and recover devices across Linux, Windows, and macOS, and resolve support tickets, working from the runbooks, policies, and security controls set by the Head of Corporate Technology and alongside colleagues based mainly in Canada.
  
  
**Mandate:**

* Keep laptops and hardware for India-based staff set up, tracked, and working
* Handle routine Linux server administration using defined runbooks
* Resolve support tickets quickly and escalate what you cannot fix with clear notes
* Keep documentation, asset records, and ticket history accurate

**Must-Have Qualifications:**

* 3 to 5 years of system administration experience, including hands-on hardware and end-user support
* Strong Linux administration from the command line (Ubuntu or RHEL family): users and permissions, file systems, services, packages, and logs. Linux is non-negotiable for this role
* Experience setting up and troubleshooting web servers (Apache or Nginx) on Linux, with Bash scripting for routine tasks
* Comfort working across Windows 11 and macOS alongside Linux. Strong Linux plus one of the other two is acceptable
* Experience administering a directory and identity platform, such as Microsoft 365 and Entra ID or an on-premise Windows Active Directory domain
* Hardware troubleshooting and component replacement, plus networking fundamentals: IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN

**Nice to Have:**

* Active Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104) certification. Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) is a strong advantage
* An active Linux certification, such as CompTIA Linux+, RHCSA, or LFCS
* Microsoft Intune administration (device enrolment, compliance policies, app deployment)
* Exposure to DevOps tooling such as Docker, cloud virtual machines (Azure or AWS), or CI/CD runners
* PowerShell or Python scripting
* Any certification listed on your resume must be active.
* Successful candidates who do not yet hold AZ-104 and AZ-305 will be expected to complete both after joining

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Hardware & Device Support**

* Set up, image, and configure Windows 11 laptops and Mac devices for new joiners, and enrol them in device management
* Collect, wipe, and reissue devices from leavers within agreed timelines
* Troubleshoot hardware issues and coordinate repairs and warranty claims with OEMs and local vendors
* Maintain the asset register for every device, linked to the employee it is assigned to
* Support Bengaluru office equipment, including network devices, Wi-Fi, printers, and meeting room technology

**Linux System Administration**

* Perform routine Linux server administration: user accounts, permissions, service restarts, disk space, and log checks
* Apply OS updates and patches following the schedule and runbooks set by Corporate Technology
* Monitor server health alerts and escalate issues to senior team members with clear notes
* Run scheduled backup checks and report any failures

**User Support**

* Respond to and resolve support tickets for hardware, software, accounts, and access
* Support Microsoft 365 account setup, password resets, and MFA enrolment
* Escalate issues you cannot resolve to the right owner in Corporate Technology or DevOps, with the steps already taken
* Give staff practical guidance on using their devices safely

**Security & Compliance**

* Confirm endpoint protection, disk encryption, and required updates are active on every device
* Follow the access, device, and data handling policies set by Corporate Technology
* Report suspected security incidents immediately
* Support license and subscription tracking by assigning and reclaiming seats for joiners and leavers

**Documentation & Improvement**

* Keep tickets, asset records, and runbooks current
* Document recurring issues and their fixes so the team can resolve them faster next time
* Write simple scripts to automate repetitive tasks, reviewed by senior team members

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days:**
**30 Days In**

* Learn FIQ's systems, tools, ticketing process, and runbooks
* Set up devices for new joiners independently
* Reconcile the India asset register against active headcount
* Build working relationships with the Corporate Technology and DevOps teams

**60 Days In**

* Resolve support tickets within agreed response and resolution times
* Handle routine Linux administration and patching independently using runbooks
* Own joiner and leaver device workflows from start to finish

**90 Days In**

* Be the go-to contact for hardware and device support in India
* Add runbook entries for the most common recurring issues
* Deliver at least one script that removes a manual step from a routine task

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Ticket response and resolution times
* New joiner devices ready on Day 1, and leaver devices recovered on time
* Asset register accuracy
* Patch compliance on assigned servers and devices
* Internal customer satisfaction

**Interview Process:**

* Screening call with our Talent Acquisition team
* A 90-minute in-person technical assessment at our Bengaluru office with the Head of Corporate Technology. The first part is scenario-based Q&A. The second part is hands-on at a computer: you will work in a Linux environment, set up a web server, and troubleshoot basic operations on that server, and you will be questioned on networking and typical hardware issues

**Why You'll Love Working Here:**
At Fulfillment IQ, we don't just build supply chain solutions; we build long-term careers.
  
  
We believe in giving our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you're leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have a visible impact.
  
  
We operate with a high-trust, high-standards culture that values clear thinking, collaboration, and accountability without unnecessary hierarchy or bureaucracy.
  
  
Here's what makes Fulfillment IQ a rewarding place to work:
  
  
**Work That Matters**
You'll help solve real operational challenges that directly impact global commerce, customer experience, and supply chain performance.
  
  
**Career Growth That Matters**
We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning — supporting both vertical growth and long-term career progression.
  
  
**Flexibility to Thrive**
We support remote and hybrid work models, flexible schedules, and trust our teams to manage their time responsibly.
  
  
**We Celebrate Impact**
From project wins to personal milestones, we recognize contribution, celebrate progress, and value consistency over heroics.
  
  
**A Collaborative Culture**
You'll work alongside experienced consultants, engineers, product leaders, and commercial professionals who value ownership, transparency, and high standards.
  
  
**Perks you'll appreciate:**
**Health and Wellness**

* Comprehensive group medical insurance for you and your family, in line with local practice
* Employee wellness programs where applicable

**Time Off**

* Competitive paid time off, sick leave, and public holidays
* Flexible leave policies that respect local labour standards

**Retirement and Financial Security**

* Statutory retirement and social security contributions (Employees' Provident Fund, Employees' State Insurance where applicable, and gratuity)
* Employee stock options (ESOP), where applicable

**Professional Growth**

* Dedicated learning and development budget, with support for skills, leadership, and career progression

**Flexible Work**

* Remote and hybrid work options, flexible hours aligned to role and client needs

**Additional Perks**

* Equipment and workstation allowances, internet and business travel reimbursements, team events and offsites

**Work Authorization:**

* Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India.

**Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring:**
FIQ uses artificial intelligence to assist in the screening, assessment, and shortlisting of applications for this position, including features within our applicant tracking system. AI supports human reviewers and does not make hiring decisions on its own. Final hiring decisions are made by FIQ personnel. If you have questions about how AI is used in this process, contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com.
  
  
**Accommodations:**
FIQ is committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Consistent with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, accommodations are available on request at any stage of recruitment and assessment. Contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com, and we will work with you to meet your needs.
  
  
**Candidate Privacy:**
Your personal information is collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with FIQ's Candidate Privacy Notice, available at here, and in accordance with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. This includes the use of AI-assisted screening described above and cross-border storage or processing that may occur in the United States. By applying, you acknowledge this notice. Questions: hr@fulfillmentiq.com.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity:**
Fulfillment IQ is a people-first company built on trust, collaboration, and ownership. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workplace. We provide equal opportunity in line with the Constitution of India and consider all qualified applicants without regard to religion, race, caste, sex, place of birth, disability, or any other characteristic protected under applicable Indian law.
  
  
**Safe and Respectful Workplace:**
FIQ maintains a safe and respectful workplace and complies with the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH). We have a constituted Internal Committee to receive and address complaints, and every employee is covered by our anti-harassment policy from day one.

* Strong documentation, analytical, stakeholder management, and consulting skills.

* Strong communication, problem-solving, and client-facing skills.

title: Senior Staff Engineer - Infrastructure Software
description:
**Netradyne**
harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Infra-Dev team builds the software that runs Netradyne's cloud infrastructure. We write the internal platforms, automation and AI agents that DevOps, Database and engineering teams use every day: cloud cost analytics and anomaly detection, self-service service provisioning on AWS, an internal developer platform on Kubernetes, database access and upgrade automation, S3 data lifecycle and retention, and agentic tooling for infrastructure operations and on-call.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership for Infra-Dev. You will own the team's technical goals and major platforms, decide how new initiatives are approached, and stay hands-on in design and code. You bring wide-ranging experience across cloud infrastructure, software engineering, databases and cost management, and you understand how these disciplines affect one another.
  
  
**Role And Responsibilities**

* Act as technical owner and architect for Infra-Dev's major platforms: the cloud operations and cost platform, the service provisioning tooling, the internal developer platform and infrastructure AI agents.
* Lead the design and delivery of multi-quarter initiatives such as containerising services onto Kubernetes (EKS), GitOps-based internal developer platforms, an infrastructure registry of service and resource dependencies, and infrastructure-as-code standardisation.
* Decide the methods, tools and standards for new assignments, including build-vs-buy evaluations, technology selection and migration plans.
* Lead cloud cost management (FinOps) engineering: cost allocation and unit economics (for example, cost per device or per feature), forecasting, anomaly detection, Savings Plans and Reserved Instance coverage, and COGS/OpEx reporting for engineering and finance leadership.
* Act as a technical point of contact for Finance and cloud vendors (AWS account and TAM teams, tooling vendors) on cost analysis, forecasts, commitments and renewals.
* Own the architecture of data lifecycle and storage-cost programs for petabyte-scale S3 data: retention policies, storage-class transitions, data retirement and safe deletion with customer-specific exceptions.
* Run the team's recurring cost and operations reviews, turning findings into prioritised engineering work and measurable savings.
* Define the architecture for agentic infrastructure operations: triage and on-call agents, MCP gateways and human-in-the-loop approvals, with clear security guardrails.
* Set standards for database and access automation across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, OpenSearch, ClickHouse and DynamoDB, working closely with the Database team.
* Provide architecture guidance on shared infrastructure that DevOps and Database teams depend on, including logging pipelines, internal PKI and certificates, Kubernetes secrets management and device-to-cloud ingestion (IoT, Kinesis Video Streams).
* Drive security and compliance-by-default in infrastructure tooling: least-privilege IAM, credential lifecycle, secrets management, tagging and audit reporting.
* Lead architecture and design reviews, RFCs and technical decisions for Infra-Dev, and review designs from DevOps and Database teams where they intersect.
* Identify and address scalability, reliability, cost and security risks across the infrastructure stack before they become incidents.
* Lead investigation of complex production issues that cross application, database, network and cloud layers, and drive lasting fixes.
* Plan sprints and roadmaps with engineering leadership: break down work, manage dependencies, track delivery and report progress with team metrics.
* Make sure critical knowledge is written down: design documents, runbooks and ownership maps for every system the team runs.
* Mentor and grow engineers through design guidance, code reviews and career coaching.
* Take part in hiring, interviews and onboarding for the Infra teams.

**Essential Skills**

* 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including significant experience building infrastructure, platform, DevOps or SRE software at scale.
* Expert programming skills in Python and/or Go, with a strong record of production-quality code and code review.
* Deep, hands-on AWS expertise across compute, networking, IAM, storage, databases, messaging and billing, including multi-account and multi-cluster environments.
* Strong experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and the cloud-native ecosystem: Helm, Argo CD, Crossplane, service networking and autoscaling.
* Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Terragrunt or equivalent) and designing reusable modules and golden paths.
* Strong experience designing CI/CD pipelines and safe deployment strategies across multiple environments.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems: reliability, fault tolerance, idempotency, retries and capacity planning.
* Strong understanding of database operations and internals for relational and NoSQL data stores.
* Experience with cloud cost management, including cost data pipelines, cost allocation and commitment-based discounts.
* Proven ability to determine methods and approaches on new, loosely defined assignments and to evaluate trade-offs across many variables.
* Proven technical leadership: driving multi-person initiatives and mentoring engineers while staying hands-on.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs, risks and cost impact to engineering and business leaders.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience building LLM agents and AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, Strands or LangGraph, MCP, vector databases, agent observability).
* Experience building internal developer platforms or platform-engineering products used by many teams.
* Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry or the ELK stack.
* Experience with Snowflake, data warehouses and forecasting or anomaly detection techniques (e.g., Prophet, regression models).
* Experience with IoT or device platforms and large-scale data ingestion.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

**Leadership & Management Expectations**

* Act as the senior technical leader and approver for Infra-Dev, and own team goals for its tactical business targets.
* Support the decisions and goals of the wider Infrastructure function (DevOps, Database and Infra-Dev); your work is reviewed on completion.
* Understand how infrastructure, application engineering, security and finance depend on one another, and design solutions that work across them.
* Direct how existing engineering principles are applied in Infra-Dev, and guide the development of new infrastructure policies and standards.
* Build a culture of engineering quality, ownership, automation and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications And Education Requirements**

* B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typically requires 8+ years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree, 6+ years with a Master's degree, or a PhD with 3+ years of experience.

* Direct exposure to enterprise-scale cloud security migrations.
* Competitive compensation and clear technical career progression.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**Description**
Enphase Energy is a global energy technology company and a leading provider of solar, battery, and electric vehicle charging products. Founded in 2006, our innovative microinverter technology revolutionized solar power, making it a safer, more reliable, and scalable energy source. Today, the Enphase Energy System enables users to make, use, save, and sell their own power. Enphase is also one of the most successful and innovative clean energy companies in the world, with more than 80 million products shipped across 160 countries.
  
  
This role at Enphase requires working onsite
**3 days a week**
, with plans to transition back to a full 5 day in office schedule over time.
  
  
**About the role**
**:**
As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and maintaining enterprise network infrastructure across global locations. This includes switches, routers, firewalls, wireless access points, SD-WAN, data centres, distribution centres, and co-location facilities.
  
  
You will play a key role in ensuring the availability, performance, security, and reliability of critical network services that support business operations. You will work closely with global IT teams, security teams, vendors, and service providers to troubleshoot complex network issues, implement network improvements, and maintain resilient and scalable network infrastructure.
  
  
**What you will do**
**:**
Join our dynamic teams designing and developing next-gen energy technologies and help drive a sustainable future!
  
  

* Design, configure, implement, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, wireless access points, and SD-WAN solutions.
* Administer and troubleshoot Palo Alto firewalls, including security policies, NAT, VPNs, IPsec tunnels, and site-to-site connectivity.
* Monitor network performance, identify potential issues, and proactively resolve network outages, latency, packet loss, and connectivity problems.
* Manage and troubleshoot routing and switching technologies, including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, STP, and Layer 2/Layer 3 connectivity.
* Manage network connectivity across data centers, cloud environments, distribution centers, offices, and co-location facilities.
* Troubleshoot site-to-site VPNs, remote connectivity, and IPsec/IKE tunnel issues to ensure secure and reliable communication between locations.
* Coordinate with telecom vendors and service providers for internet circuits, WAN links, circuit provisioning, outages, and service restoration.
* Support network changes, upgrades, migrations, and infrastructure expansion while minimizing business disruption.
* Implement and maintain network security best practices, access controls, firewall rules, and network segmentation.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for network incidents and implement corrective and preventive actions to avoid recurrence.
* Monitor network health using network monitoring, logging, and diagnostic tools, and maintain accurate network documentation.

title: Network System Test Engineer (Manual/Solution)
description:
**Company Description**
**Arista Networks**
is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $8 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
  
  
At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
  
  
Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Who You’ll Work With**
You will work with software development engineers, hardware engineers, field support engineers, product managers, and software test engineers to analyse customer requirements and use cases, gather technical details, create software test plans, and validate that the product meets our customer’s requirements. You will also work with our customer support and engineering teams to help address escalated customer issues by reproducing, and debugging those in the lab.
  
  
The role will provide opportunities to create real impact in the rapidly growing Cloud IT services, and virtualization technologies.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Arista Networks is looking for world-class Software Test Engineers (aka System Test engineers) to help us in building the highest quality networking products. If you love networking. If working on complex & scaled out network topologies makes you excited.
  
  
If you like to challenge yourself to find the hard-to-find bugs and if troubleshooting & debugging network and system problems gives you a thrill, this role is tailor made for you.
  
  
At Arista, you’ll bring your intelligence, creativity, and drive every day & work with our products exactly how they are going to be used by our end customers and while doing so, make sure that the products are going to work every time.
  
  
Your job is to find the hard bugs, the ones not easily exposed by the developers’ automated unit and product level tests. You will NOT spend your time running manual regressions of mind numbing, 1000 page test plans, because Arista’s developers automate all the basic functional and integration tests.
  
  
Courtesy our super collaborative work environment, you’ll spend your time embedded deeply with multiple engineering teams, working side by side with the developers, POC engineers, account teams, working together as one team and do all of it to help us to explore, find and fix software problems before they can reach the customers. We take quality seriously and we invite you to be a champion of software quality!!
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Experience & Education: BE/ B.Tech/ME/ M. Tech with networking industry experience.
* Proven expertise in creating test methodologies and writing test plans.
* Strong knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Ethernet, RSTP/ MSTP, VLANs, IP Routing, TCP/IP, OSPF, IS-IS, BGP, IGMP, PIM SM/SSM, QoS, L2-L3 protocols, Platform validation, HA, QOS, network management.
* Experience with IXIA and/or Spirent test tools desired.
* Work with the developers on your team in creating their plans for automated tests to complement the exploratory testing that you perform.
* Participate in functional specification and software design reviews held by your team and provide customer centric input.
* Work in a highly productive environment along with best of the engineers on Linux platform that cuts a typical development cycle by order of magnitude with a laser focus towards quality.
* Use every means possible to find the bugs in the software and/or hardware being developed by your team.
* Write test plans to validate Arista features and products.
* Design test network topologies to validate functionality, performance, stability and scalability of features and products.
* Execute test plans to verify all aspects of the product. Identify defects and validate resolution.
* Work as an agile member of a combined development and test team, running in short cycles to develop functional software in quick iterations.

**Additional Information**
Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
  
  
We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
  
  
Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature.
  
  
Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

* Hands-on work with the latest 5G, mmWave, and SDR hardware
* Exposure to both research labs and industry deployments
* Real ownership of demos and projects from day one
* Learning-focused culture with room to grow into senior technical roles

* Experience with programming or scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar to automate system management and operational tasks.
* Bachelors degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**

* Industry certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer, or Azure DevOps Engineer, or equivalent certifications.
* Experience with multicloud or hybrid cloud deployments, including cloud data migration tools and strategies.
* Experience with resilience-focused practices such as chaos engineering, resilience testing frameworks, and service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and error budgets.

title: Infrastructure Automation Specialist – Python, Ansible, F5 LTM/GTM & Network APIs
description:
****Job Summary****
Synechron is seeking an Infrastructure Automation Engineer to implement and maintain automation solutions for infrastructure certification, plant management, and infrastructure-on-demand services. The role requires hands-on experience with Python, Ansible, infrastructure APIs, F5 load balancers, networking protocols, Linux-based environments, and lab-based testing.The Infrastructure Automation Engineer will work with internal clients and stakeholders to understand business requirements and design well-architected solutions. The role contributes to business objectives by improving infrastructure provisioning, certification efficiency, operational consistency, test coverage, deployment speed, and service reliability.
  
  
****Software Requirements****
**Required Software Skills**

* Python: Hands-on experience automating infrastructure installation, configuration, management, certification, and testing activities.
* Ansible: Practical experience developing and maintaining playbooks, roles, automation workflows, and infrastructure configuration processes.
* Shell scripting: Experience using shell or other scripting/programming languages to automate repetitive infrastructure tasks.
* F5 LTM and GTM: Expertise in configuration, administration, troubleshooting, and API-based integration.
* F5 TMSH, iControl, and iRules: Practical experience using these capabilities for configuration, automation, service management, and integration.
* Networking technologies: Strong understanding of TCP/IP, BGP, HTTP, SSL, and networking concepts across all relevant layers.
* Linux command line: Comfort working in Linux-based environments for configuration, troubleshooting, automation, testing, and operational support.
* Infrastructure APIs: Experience extending and integrating APIs to provide infrastructure-on-demand capabilities.
* Lab-based testing: Experience performing and automating testing for new hardware and software certification.
* Software versions: Experience working with the Python, Ansible, Linux, F5, networking, API, automation, and testing tool versions used by the assigned Synechron project. Ability to assess compatibility and upgrade considerations is required.

****Preferred Software Skills****

* Experience with additional programming or scripting languages.
* Hands-on experience deploying and configuring network infrastructure, including Cisco, Arista, or comparable platforms.
* Experience with the Infoblox suite of DNS and DHCP products.
* Knowledge of virtualized and containerized infrastructure.
* Understanding of software version control, deployment, build tools, and software development lifecycle practices.
* Experience with infrastructure testing, continuous integration, continuous delivery, or automated release tools.
* Recognized industry certifications from F5, Cisco, or other relevant technology vendors.

Equivalent tools and platforms may be considered where they provide comparable capabilities.
  
  
****Overall Responsibilities****

* Implement automation for certification and plant management using Python and Ansible.
* Automate repetitive infrastructure installation, configuration, provisioning, management, and validation tasks.
* Extend and integrate APIs to provide infrastructure-on-demand capabilities.
* Design, develop, test, document, and maintain automation workflows and reusable components.

* Support infrastructure certification outcomes by ensuring that test activities are repeatable, traceable, and aligned with defined requirements.
* Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to infrastructure automation, testing, deployment, and service delivery.
* Consider sustainability by reducing manual rework, improving resource utilization, reusing automation components, and minimizing unnecessary infrastructure provisioning and test activity.
* Deliver automation solutions that meet agreed requirements for functionality, reliability, security, maintainability, and operational support.

****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****

* Python for infrastructure automation, API integration, configuration management, testing, and operational tooling.
* Shell scripting or another scripting/programming language for infrastructure automation and command-line operations.
* Ability to write maintainable, reusable, testable, and well-documented automation code.
* Ability to troubleshoot scripts, automation workflows, API interactions, and infrastructure-related failures.

****Preferred****

* Experience with additional programming languages used for automation, infrastructure management, testing, or software development.
* Familiarity with structured data formats and API data exchange, including JSON or YAML.

**Databases/Data Management**
****Essential****

* Understanding of configuration data, infrastructure inventory, service metadata, test results, and certification records.
* Ability to manage, validate, and document data used by automation workflows and infrastructure APIs.
* Experience working with structured configuration files and data exchanged through APIs.

****Preferred****

**Cloud Technologies**

****Preferred****

**Frameworks and Libraries**

****Essential****

title: GMS-Senior-Zero Trust Network Access
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description: Senior Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) Engineer**
**Experience Level: 3–5 Years**
**Role Type: Full-Time**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Senior Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) Engineer to architect, deploy, and manage our modern identity-centric perimeter security solutions. Spanning the complete service delivery lifecycle—Assess, Build, Transition, and Operations—this role is pivotal in replacing legacy VPN architectures with least-privilege, context-aware access controls. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience integrating ZTNA platforms with enterprise Identity Providers (IdP), enforcing device posture checks, and securing hybrid enterprise applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Assess (Architecture Review & Posture Analysis)**

* Conduct comprehensive audits of existing remote access models, legacy VPN concentrators, and internal application exposure.
* Analyze user access patterns, application dependencies, and data flows to map out micro-segmentation and least-privilege policies.
* Evaluate current Identity Provider (IdP) readiness, multi-factor authentication (MFA) enforcement, and endpoint device posture compliance mechanisms.

**Build (Deployment & Policy Engineering)**

* Deploy, configure, and manage enterprise ZTNA solutions (e.g., Zscaler ZPA, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cloudflare One, or Cisco Secure Access).
* Design and implement context-aware access policies combining user identity, device health, location, and risk scores.
* Provision and configure ZTNA connectors (gateways/brokers) across on-premise data centers, AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.
* Integrate ZTNA platforms with enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) and Directory Services (e.g., Entra ID/Azure AD, Okta).

**Transition (Migration, Testing & Handover)**

* Drive the phased migration roadmap from legacy VPN solutions to ZTNA with minimal disruption to business units.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business application owners to validate seamless context-based access.
* Develop "As-Built" architecture diagrams, policy migration runbooks, and troubleshooting guides for support desks.
* Conduct enablement sessions for IT helpdesks and operations teams on ZTNA client troubleshooting and policy management.

**Operations & Continuous Management**

* Serve as the senior escalation point for complex ZTNA connectivity, identity assertion, and connector health issues.
* Perform continuous policy lifecycle management, reviewing access rules, removing stale policies, and refining posture checks.
* Monitor ZTNA tunnel performance, broker throughput, and client app stability across global endpoints.
* Ensure real-time security telemetry and access logs stream successfully into the SIEM for threat hunting and compliance monitoring.
* Understanding of ITIL-based Change Management, managing end-to-end change lifecycle activities, CAB coordination, and compliant implementation of infrastructure and application changes

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience: 3–5 years of dedicated experience in network security, identity and access management (IAM), or zero trust architecture implementation.
* Core Technologies: Hands-on expertise with market-leading ZTNA platforms (e.g., Zscaler Private Access, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cloudflare One, or Microsoft Global Secure Access).
* Identity & Networking: Strong grasp of IAM principles, SAML/OIDC authentication protocols, Active Directory/Entra ID, and foundational networking (DNS, TCP/IP, routing, firewalls).
* Zero Trust Principles: Deep understanding of "Never Trust, Always Verify" paradigms, micro-segmentation, and device posture validation frameworks.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (Mission Control & Ground Segment)
description:
ReOrbit is looking for a Senior Cloud Infra Engineer to own and scale our Azure cloud infrastructure from our Bangalore office.
  
  
As our Senior Cloud Infra Engineer, you will be the technical owner of ReOrbit’s cloud platform, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Bangalore as part of our two-hub operating model. You will take over work currently delivered by an external DevOps and infrastructure consultant, with structured knowledge transfer in your first months.
  
  
You will be responsible for the architecture, automation, security and reliability of our cloud environment. As the role matures, you will grow into owning the cloud infrastructure, automation and reliability engineering for our Mission Control and Ground Segment.
  
  
It’s an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own Azure platform architecture, provisioning and governance across ReOrbit’s cloud environment.
* Manage network infrastructure design, security groups, VPNs and connectivity.
* Own infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / ARM) for repeatable, auditable deployments.
* Design, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.
* Drive infrastructure automation, including provisioning, configuration management and self-healing systems.
* Implement and own monitoring, alerting and observability tooling across cloud infrastructure.
* Own disaster recovery and business continuity planning, and lead incident response and root-cause analysis.
* Implement security controls across cloud infrastructure in partnership with the Head of Security.
* Document architecture, runbooks and procedures, lead knowledge transfer from the current external DevOps consultant, and coordinate with vendors.
* Grow into ownership of Mission Control and Ground Segment cloud infrastructure, automation and reliability engineering as the role matures.

**Skills And Requirements**

* 8–10 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud or Infrastructure engineering roles.
* Deep hands-on Microsoft Azure experience (compute, networking, storage, IAM).
* CI/CD pipeline design and infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform / ARM / Bicep).
* Strong networking and security fundamentals (VPNs, segmentation, access control).
* Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus or equivalent).
* Experience owning production infrastructure reliability and incident response.
* Comfortable working toward mission-critical, high-availability system ownership.
* Fluent English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in aerospace, satellite or other mission-critical operational environments.
* Kubernetes or other container orchestration experience.
* Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-500 or equivalent).
* Experience transitioning work from external consultants or vendors into an internal team.
* Scripting ability (Python, PowerShell or Bash) for automation.
* Exposure to ground segment, SCADA or other real-time operational systems.
* Experience scaling infrastructure ownership from start-up to enterprise.

**Working mode**

* Location: Bangalore, India, working from the office with one work-from-home day per week.
* On-call support may be required outside working hours. Please make sure you are comfortable with this before applying.

**What does ReOrbit do?**
ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities.
  
  
ReOrbit’s top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiary in Bariloche, Argentina.
  
  
**Working at ReOrbit**
At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We’re all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength.
  
  
We offer
  
  

* Challenging but rewarding environment – you will thrive if you are always reflecting on how to make things better. Your ideas will be heard.
* Ambitious and supportive network of people, who are motivated to change the space industry, bringing expertise from both classic and new space .
* Benefits such as lunch vouchers, events, parties, occupational health care and additional health insurance - but most importantly a possibility to be a part of a unique and diverse team, connected by similar mindset and sense of humor.
* We like to spend time together! You can choose activities whichever is to your liking – runOrbit, climbOrbit; become ping pong or board games champion.
* We support relocation and integration into Finnish society, find some experiences about relocation here

Please, submit your application as soon as possible - we are excited to hear from you and can’t wait to discover your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
*For agencies: We do not accept unsolicited CVs for our open vacancies. Any CV sent to our team unsolicited will reserve us the right to pursue a candidate without obligation to the sender. All candidate submissions must be conducted through our official channels and in accordance with our terms of engagement.*

title: Senior Support Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a Senior Support Engineer to join our Cloud Customer Support organization. In this role, you will independently investigate and resolve complex cloud and infrastructure challenges, driving customer issues through timely and effective resolution. You will collaborate with Engineering and Operations, mentor fellow engineers, and drive continuous improvements that strengthen service reliability and deliver an exceptional customer experience.
  
  
As a Senior Support Engineer, you will serve as a trusted technical interface for OCI customers, applying strong technical judgment and structured troubleshooting to challenging production issues. You will work across cloud infrastructure technologies, analyze technical evidence, identify potential causes, and engage the appropriate teams when an issue requires cross-functional expertise.
  
  
You will own customer issues throughout the support lifecycle, maintaining clear and proactive communication while balancing technical depth, urgency, and customer impact. Your work may involve complex or multi-technology scenarios where the resolution path is not immediately known, requiring independent investigation, effective technical judgment, and timely collaboration with subject matter experts to drive issues toward resolution.
  
  
Beyond resolving individual incidents, you will contribute to the effectiveness of the broader Support organization by sharing technical knowledge, mentoring engineers, improving troubleshooting practices and documentation, and identifying opportunities to improve support processes and customer outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Independently investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex customer issues involving cloud infrastructure and related technologies.
* Own customer issues throughout the support lifecycle, driving timely progress while maintaining high standards of technical quality and customer communication.
* Apply structured troubleshooting methodologies using logs, telemetry, diagnostic tools, technical documentation, runbooks, and engineering experience to isolate problems and determine appropriate next steps.
* Troubleshoot across multiple infrastructure technologies, including compute, networking, operating systems, storage, virtualization, and related cloud services.
* Work effectively with customers during complex or business-impacting incidents, providing clear technical guidance, meaningful progress updates, and well-defined next steps.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Service Operations, and other technical teams to investigate cross-service issues, identify product-related issues, and restore customer services.
* Escalate issues appropriately when additional expertise is required while continuing to maintain ownership of the customer experience and support engagement.
* Identify recurring technical and operational issues and contribute recommendations that improve troubleshooting effectiveness, service reliability, support processes, and customer experience.
* Create and improve technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks that enable consistent and efficient issue resolution.
* Share technical knowledge, troubleshooting techniques, and best practices with peers and mentor less-experienced engineers.
* Contribute to team projects and initiatives that improve support quality, operational efficiency, case handling, and customer outcomes.
* Capture key technical findings and lessons learned from customer incidents to improve organizational knowledge and future troubleshooting effectiveness.
* Continuously develop expertise across OCI services, cloud infrastructure, and technologies relevant to the supported environment.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Engineering, or a related technical filed.
* At least 4 years of relevant technical experience and at least 6 years of overall professional experience.
* Demonstrated experience supporting, operating, administering, or troubleshooting cloud infrastructure, enterprise infrastructure, or related technologies.
* Strong understanding of cloud computing and infrastructure concepts, with demonstrated troubleshooting and problem-solving capability.
* Ability to independently investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, and drive effective resolution.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure technologies such as compute, networking, operating systems, storage, and virtualization.
* Ability to analyze logs, system behavior, diagnostic information, and other technical evidence to isolate issues and determine appropriate actions.
* Strong customer orientation and the ability to manage technically challenging customer situations with professionalism, urgency, and empathy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Support, Engineering, Operations, and other technical teams.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies, apply that knowledge to customer problems, and share technical knowledge with others.
* Atleast 2 completed cloud certifications from recognized cloud providers.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in cloud technical support, infrastructure support, production operations, NOC, SRE, systems engineering, or a comparable technical environment.
* Strong understanding of Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), particularly Compute, Storage and Networking.
* Hands-on troubleshooting experience with Linux and/or Windows operating systems.
* Knowledge of networking concepts and technologies such as TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing, and network connectivity troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with virtualization, storage, and distributed cloud infrastructure.
* Experience supporting enterprise customers and managing complex or business-impacting production incidents.
* Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, or operational runbooks.
* Familiarity with scripting, automation, diagnostic tooling, APIs, or software development concepts.
* Understanding of cloud security, operational best practices, and relevant industry security and compliance standards.

**Location & Work Schedule:**

* This is a full-time, permanent position based in Bengaluru, India.
* The role supports a global customer environment and requires flexibility to work assigned shifts, including rotational weekend and holiday coverage, based on business needs.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Radio Engineer II
description:
**Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Radio Engineer II to deliver radiofrequency and wireless system designs for railway, metro, light rail, depot, station, tunnel and building projects. * Develop concept, tender and detailed designs for Wi-Fi, TETRA, public-safety radio, cellular DAS, LTE/5G, private mobile radio and other project-specific wireless systems.
* Prepare radio and wireless architectures for stations, platforms, tunnels, depots, workshops, stabling areas, control centres, trackside areas and buildings.
* Perform RF propagation modelling, coverage and capacity analysis, interference assessment, frequency/channel planning, link-budget calculations, and design optimisation.
* Determine access-point, antenna, remote-radio-unit and repeater locations based on project requirements, validated survey inputs and applicable design criteria.
* Design passive and active DAS solutions, including antennas, feeders, splitters, couplers, combiners, cable routes and associated equipment.

* Prepare and review survey, FAT, SAT, coverage-acceptance and commissioning procedures;
* Lead assigned design packages and provide technical guidance to CAD/BIM designers for Radio drawings.
* Software and RF Design Expertise

*Ekahau*

* Create predictive Wi-Fi models using floor plans, wall types, attenuation values, antenna characteristics and project design criteria.
* Perform access-point placement, channel and power planning, capacity modelling and coverage validation for high-density and operationally critical environments.
* Plan and perform passive, active and spectrum surveys; analyse results and prepare professional survey and validation reports.

*iBwave*

* Develop iBwave models for in-building radio, cellular, public-safety and mission-critical coverage in buildings, stations, tunnels and depots.
* Configure building geometry, construction materials, RF sources, antennas and propagation parameters for reliable predictive modelling.
* Prepare DAS schematics, riser diagrams, equipment layouts, cable schedules, link budgets and coverage-compliance reports, coordinated with CAD/BIM deliverables.

*Mandatory Technical Skills*

* Expert practical experience with Ekahau for predictive Wi-Fi design, survey planning, survey analysis and reporting.

* Ability to interpret architectural, civil, MEP, railway and telecom drawings and coordinate within AutoCAD/Revit/BIM environments.

* Knowledge of relevant standards and guidelines, including IEEE 802.11 Wi-Fi standards, ETSI and Ofcom/FCC regulations, EN 50121 EMC requirements, and applicable railway telecommunications standards.
* Experience in radio systems, including leaky feeder, radiating cable, tunnel DAS, distributed antenna systems, and emergency communications coverage.
* Understanding of interfaces with SCADA, signalling, PA/VA, CCTV, passenger information systems, operational telephony, and transmission networks.
* Strong technical writing, design-calculation, stakeholder coordination and multidisciplinary communication skills.

*Rail and International Experience*

* Demonstrated radio design experience on railway, metro, light rail, station, depot, tunnel or transportation-infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated wireless design experience for complex or high-occupancy buildings.
* Experience delivering projects across multiple countries or regions and working with geographically distributed teams.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
You’ll be a senior hands-on Network Engineer at the center of highly available, global infrastructure. You’ll design, run, and improve enterprise and data center networks that thousands of users and critical applications rely on every day.
  
  
You’ll work across routing, switching, firewalls, SD‑WAN, and load balancing, primarily using Cisco, Fortinet, and F5 technologies. You’ll be the person others turn to for complex troubleshooting, resilient network design, and modernization initiatives across enterprise and private cloud environments.
  
  
If you enjoy solving tough networking problems, shaping network architecture, and partnering with security, cloud, and operations teams to keep things fast, secure, and reliable, this role gives you room to grow your technical depth and influence.
  
  
**Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do (not all of it, just the important stuff)**

* Design, deploy, and support enterprise and private cloud network infrastructure across production and non‑production environments.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex Layer 2/Layer 3 issues in mission‑critical, high‑availability networks.
* Configure and optimize Cisco Catalyst and Nexus platforms, including WAN, campus, and data center networking with BGP and OSPF.
* Support and maintain Fortinet FortiGate firewalls (including VPNs, SD‑WAN, and segmentation) to deliver secure, resilient connectivity.
* Administer and fine‑tune F5 BIG‑IP load balancing and application delivery services to keep customer and internal applications highly available.
* Lead incident/root cause analysis, contribute to modernization projects, and maintain clear technical documentation, standards, and network diagrams.

**These are the essentials you’ll need to get an interview**

* 7+ years of hands-on experience as a Network Engineer in an enterprise or data center environment.

+ Phoenix Contact: SWITCH series and security routers

title: NOC Engineer
description:
Shift Model: 24×7 Network Operations Center (Rotational Shifts), 3 shifts: 8-5 est, 5-2am, 12am-9am

**Key Responsibilities**

• Proactively monitor enterprise and cloud networks using tools such as CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Splunk, Grafana, SolarWinds.

• Perform deep troubleshooting and root cause analysis for network incidents, including routing anomalies, intermittent connectivity, packet loss, DNS failures, VPN tunnel instability, firewall and load balancer misconfigurations — not limited to monitoring-only activities.

• Own end-to-end incident resolution within the NOC, driving investigation, remediation, and validation until full service restoration.

• Act as L2/L3 escalation point for complex network issues within the NOC.

• Participate in Major Incident Management (MIM) bridges and support recovery actions.

• Operate AWS and Azure networking including VPC/VNet, subnets, routing tables, Transit Gateway/VWAN, load balancers, VPNs, ExpressRoute/Direct Connect.

• Troubleshoot hybrid connectivity between cloud, on-prem, and third-party providers.

• Operate and troubleshoot firewalls, WAF, NSGs/Security Groups, and VPNs.

• Execute pre-approved network changes following SOPs and change management processes.

• Maintain accurate incident records and documentation in ServiceNow.

• Improve runbooks, alert hygiene, dashboards, and automation.

• Provide clear shift handovers for follow-the-sun operations.

**Must Have Skills:**

* TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP fundamentals
* BGP / OSPF routing knowledge
* AWS networking and monitoring
* Load balancers, VPN, firewalls
* Hybrid cloud connectivity troubleshooting
* Monitoring: CloudWatch, Splunk

**Role Overview:**

The NOC Engineer is a hands-on operations role responsible for 24×7 monitoring, incident response, and operational stability of enterprise and cloud networking platforms. This role acts as a network escalation authority within the NOC, ensuring rapid detection, diagnosis, and resolution of network and connectivity-related incidents across AWS, Azure, hybrid, and on-prem environments. The engineer works within a disciplined ITIL-based NOC to meet SLAs and reduce MTTR.

This role requires experience working within a global enterprise environment, supporting business-critical platforms across multiple regions and time zones. The engineer must collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams and vendors, ensuring consistent service delivery and clear communication during incidents.

title: Senior Platform Engineer, Network Infrastructure
description:
Cloud Foundations Reliability (CFR) is part of NVIDIA’s Global Network Infrastructure (GNI) organization. We deploy, integrate, and operate the Kubernetes-based platform and shared services used to provision, monitor, and operate NVIDIA’s global network across data centers, colocation facilities, and cloud environments. The team owns the architecture and lifecycle of this platform, including cluster provisioning and upgrades, GitOps delivery, observability, capacity, and service enablement. We build software and automation to standardize how network platforms and services are deployed, scaled, and managed across environments.
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer to own the lifecycle and automation of the Kubernetes platform supporting GNI network systems. You will also provide production support for network services running on the platform, partnering with their engineering owners when issues or changes cross the platform boundary. You will take complex problems from design through production and remain accountable for the outcome. You will bring deep Kubernetes expertise and help establish consistent engineering practices across the US and Bangalore teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership and production responsibility.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Design, build, and operate the Kubernetes platform that powers GNI network automation, telemetry, and operations across data center, colocation, and cloud environments.
* Own the lifecycle management for GNI Kubernetes environments, including cluster onboarding, upgrades, capacity, availability, and recovery.
* Develop production-quality software and automation for cluster provisioning, validation, upgrades, remediation, and safe multi-cluster delivery through GitOps.
* Provide production support for network services hosted on the platform, working with Network Automation and service teams that retain ownership of application architecture, code, and features.
* Diagnose complex Kubernetes platform and hosted-service failures involving control-plane health, cluster networking, storage, scheduling, workload placement, and multi-cluster dependencies. Drive issues from initial signal through verified resolution.
* Define production-readiness and observability standards for the platform and hosted network services, including health signals, capacity, alerts, runbooks, and recovery.
* Participate in CFR’s production on-call rotation, including scheduled after-hours and weekend coverage. Lead incident response and recovery, then drive corrective actions to completion.

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience building or operating production Kubernetes platforms, network infrastructure, or distributed systems.
* Deep experience with Kubernetes at scale, including cluster lifecycle, upgrades, networking, storage, and recovery.
* Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Go or Python.
* Experience with GitOps, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and automated production delivery.
* Experience deploying and supporting network automation or telemetry services on Kubernetes.
* Experience with production on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis, and driving corrective actions to completion.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Strong knowledge of IP routing, data center fabrics, and cloud networking is a great plus.
* Experience designing and operating large, multi-region Kubernetes fleets, including fleet-wide upgrades and recovery.
* Hands-on experience with Cluster API (CAPI) and Metal3 for bare-metal provisioning, cluster lifecycle, machine remediation, and upgrades.
* Experience building Kubernetes controllers or operators in Go using custom resources and reconciliation patterns. Experience designing or operating network automation and telemetry services on Kubernetes at global scale.
* Contributions to Cluster API, Metal3, or other open-source Kubernetes infrastructure projects.

**Role Summary:** 




  





 The Senior Support Specialist is a senior security practitioner responsible for defending the organization’s network, infrastructure, and cloud environments against internal and external threats. This role operates at the intersection of security engineering and operations, with direct ownership of network security controls, threat detection, and incident response. Support responsibilities exist to enable security outcomes, not as an end in themselves.
 



 This position requires hands\-on expertise, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to identify systemic risk before it becomes an incident.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities:** 




  





**Network Security Ownership** 



* Architect, deploy, and continuously harden network security controls including firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, segmentation, and zero\-trust access models.
* Own network perimeter and internal trust boundaries, including firewall policy design, rule lifecycle management, and access validation.
* Actively monitor network traffic and telemetry to identify indicators of compromise, lateral movement, and policy violations.

**Security Operations Engineering** 



* Maintain and tune security tooling including SIEM, NDR, EDR/XDR, and vulnerability management platforms.
* Define detection logic, alert thresholds, and response playbooks aligned to real threat models rather than checkbox compliance.

* Support audits and assessments by producing defensible, technically accurate evidence.
* Continuously assess gaps between documented controls and actual security posture.



  





**Architecture \& Strategic Hardening** 



* Influence infrastructure and application design decisions to reduce attack surface and blast radius.
* Identify architectural weaknesses and advocate for durable, long\-term security improvements.
* Track emerging threats and adjust defensive strategies accordingly.

* 7\+ years in security engineering, network security, SOC, or infrastructure defense roles.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with enterprise networking and security architectures.
* Proven incident response experience involving real\-world security events.
* Strong understanding of attacker techniques, lateral movement, and network\-based threats.
* Experience securing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).



  





**Preferred Experience:** 




  




* Security certifications (CISSP, GSEC, GCIA, CySA\+, or equivalent).
* Experience operating within SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar frameworks.
* Scripting or automation capability to improve detection, response, or control enforcement.
* Background supporting SaaS, high\-availability, or distributed environments.



  





**What Success Looks Like:** 




  




* Security incidents are detected earlier and contained faster.
* Network access is tightly controlled, auditable, and aligned with least\-privilege principles.
* Recurring issues are eliminated through structural fixes rather than repeated response.
* Security is embedded into daily operations, not bolted on after failures.

description:

 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
   

  

**Department Overview**
 The Core Platforms \& Services team is responsible for the development and operations of critical cloud infrastructure and platform services, in support of Motorola Solutions' public and hybrid cloud\-based Software as a Service (SaaS) solutions for public safety customers. This team is part of Motorola Solutions’ Software Enterprise division, which offers secure, reliable and efficient team communications, workflow and operational intelligence solutions for mission critical public safety and enterprise markets throughout the world. Our services leverage Cloud Computing infrastructure on Azure, AWS \& GCP to build at scale.
   

  

**Job Description**
**We are seeking a highly specialized
 **Infrastructure Engineer Specialist** 
 to lead our infrastructure security efforts with a primary focus on
 **WAF configuration management** 
 and building robust
 **DevSecOps automation frameworks** 
 . This role is pivotal in bridging the gap between infrastructure stability and automated security policy enforcement across our hybrid cloud environments.**
 Basic Requirements
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* WAF Configuration \& Lifecycle Management
* Advanced WAF Engineering: Lead the lifecycle of WAF solutions, moving beyond deployment to advanced configuration management, including automated rule tuning, signature lifecycle management, and high\-precision threat policy optimization to minimize false positives.
* Automated Policy Enforcement: Develop and maintain automated workflows for translating business requirements into WAF traffic policies. Implement CI/CD pipelines that push WAF configurations as code, ensuring consistent policy application across environments.
* Optimization \& Tuning: Proactively analyze WAF logs to identify and remediate complex bot traffic and sophisticated attack patterns, ensuring high availability and optimal performance.
* DevSecOps Automation Frameworks
* Security Automation Architecture: Design and deploy automated frameworks that integrate security controls directly into infrastructure provisioning. Use tools like Terraform or Ansible to enforce security baselines as part of the standard deployment lifecycle.
* Security Observability: Configure SIEM forwarding and alerts for WAF and Network logs. You are responsible for detecting anomalies (like data exfiltration attempts or unusual traffic spikes), ensuring actionable intelligence is derived from system logs.

**About The Role**
 Anthriq’s semiconductor design company operates an on\-premise infrastructure that includes a Nutanix hyperconverged compute and VDI cluster, an EDA compute farm, NetApp storage, Fortinet networking, and a dedicated server room, alongside a Cadence Palladium emulation environment. We are seeking an IT Infrastructure Engineer to own the day\-to\-day operation, reliability, and maintenance of this infrastructure. The role covers servers, virtualization, networking, storage, backup, and server\-room operations, and works closely with the Engineering team to support the underlying host and network requirements.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the company's complete IT infrastructure end\-to\-end.
* Administer and maintain Linux (RHEL / Rocky 9\.x) and Windows servers across the environment.
* Operate and maintain the Nutanix HCI cluster (compute, VDI, and EDA compute\-farm nodes) — provisioning, patching, monitoring, and capacity management.
* Support the Palladium host servers (OS, drivers, networking, and connectivity) in coordination with the emulation engineer.
* Manage the Fortinet switches and firewall — VLANs, routing, firewall policies, and uplink/port configuration.
* Administer NetApp / NFS storage — shares, capacity, and performance.
* Own backup and disaster\-recovery operations, including scheduling, testing, and restores.
* Handle server\-room operations — racks, PDUs, UPS, cabling, and environmental monitoring — and track power and cooling headroom as the room scales.
* Automate routine administration tasks using Bash and/or Python.
* Maintain Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and general office IT services.
* Coordinate with hardware and software vendors and support partners for incidents, warranties, and renewals.
* Maintain documentation, monitoring, and basic security hygiene (patching, access control).
* Opportunity to build the Infra team as we grow.


**Requirements**
**Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure or systems and network administration. Ownership of infrastructure is preferred.
* Strong Linux administration (RHEL / Rocky) and working knowledge of Windows Server and Active Directory.
* Solid networking fundamentals — VLANs, TCP/IP, and firewall/switch administration (Fortinet experience preferred).
* Hands\-on experience with virtualization / HCI (Nutanix AHV or VMware).
* Storage administration experience (NFS / NetApp or equivalent).
* Experience implementing and testing backup and disaster\-recovery solutions.
* Scripting and automation skills in Bash and/or Python.
* Understanding of server\-room and data center operations — racks, UPS, PDU, power, and cooling.
* Ability to work independently across a broad range of technologies with strong ownership


**Good to have**
* Exposure to EDA compute farms or job schedulers (LSF, Slurm), InfiniBand, and Cadence Palladium host maintenance
* Configuration management (Ansible); monitoring tools (Zabbix/Grafana/Prometheus); relevant certifications (RHCSA/RHCE, Fortinet NSE, Nutanix NCP).

 • Designs and leads technical evolution of Platform Engineering on AWS, automation tools, frameworks, and code pipelines (continuous integration/continuous delivery pipelines),
 



 • Ensures best practices are followed with a focus on the re\-use of application code
 



 • Demonstrates consistent software delivery practices and produces continuous integration/continuous delivery platform solutions using cloud, infrastructure as code (IaC) and native container technologies.
 



 • Operates as an SME, constantly evaluating the design and building of infrastructure tooling that improves reliability across the entire product surface area at distributed scale.

 • Manages data and information to enhance the IT Operations environment to evolve to AIOps
 



 • Recommends continuous improvement opportunities to improve the site reliability engineering team processes such as through the use of AI and big data to aggregate
 



 observational data (from monitoring systems output, job logs, syslogs, etc.) and engagement data (from ticketing, incident, and event recording system data) to produce a virtuous circle of continuous insights yielding continuous improvements and fixes

 • Supports the design and implementation of robust monitoring and alerting systems
 



  





**Essential Skills / Experience** 




 • 7\+ years of hands\-on experience managing enterprise\-scale containerized infrastructure.
 



 • Strong experience across EKS, ECS, EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, and IAM.
 



 • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and ArgoCD.
 



 • Proven expertise with Terraform, Crossplane, CloudFormation, and cloud automation.
 



 • Strong understanding of GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and deployment pipelines.
 



 • Proficient in Java/Spring Boot or Python for platform engineering and automation.

 • Strong understanding of cloud security, compliance, governance, and risk management practices.
 



 • AWS Certified Professional – AWS DevOps Engineer or Solutions Architect certification (Associate/Professional) preferred.

title: Lead Engineering Manufacturing Security
description:
